title: Por más que insistan: intensificación del esfuerzo inútil
goal: Formulate intensive concessive clauses with 'por más que' and 'por mucho que' to convey maximum effort or intensity that fails to alter an outcome.
grammar: Concesión intensiva con por más que y por mucho que

sections.title: Unit 8: Concession & Counter-Argument — Lesson 3
body: Welcome to lesson 3 of Unit 8 (Concession & Counter-Argument). Mastering concessive nuances is fundamental for advanced debate, academic writing, and diplomatic discourse in Spanish.
In this lesson, we examine por más que insistan: intensificación del esfuerzo inútil, calibrating indicative vs. subjunctive triggers to construct persuasive counter-arguments.

items: Formulate intensive concessive clauses with 'por más que' and 'por mucho que' to convey maximum effort or intensity that fails to alter an outcome.
Incorporate upper-intermediate debate lexicon (el empeño, tenaz).
